subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text:
stimulus: The teacher said to the boy, "Why are you disturbing the class in this way? Don't you know that it is an important class? Get out of the room and don't come back today." "Excuse me, sir," said the boy. "I'll never disturb in the class," he promised.
guide_solution: The teacher asked the boy why he (b) was disturbing the class in that way. He (t) again asked him (b) if he (b) didn't know that it was an important class. He (t) then ordered the boy to get out of the room and not to come back that day. The boy respectfully apologized to the teacher. He (b) promised that he'd never disturb in the class.
